items.question: Which WNBA teams has Diamond DeShields played for?
items.answer: Diamond DeShields has played for the Chicago Sky and Phoenix Mercury.

items.question: What are Diamond DeShields' stats?
items.answer: In the 2024 regular season, Diamond DeShields averaged 4.5 points, 1.4 rebounds, and 1.3 assists in 32 games for the Chicago Sky.

items.question: Did Diamond DeShields play for the Dallas Wings?
items.answer: No. The Dallas Wings acquired Diamond DeShields in a trade before the 2023 season, but she did not play a game for Dallas. Her WNBA games have come with the Chicago Sky (2018 to 2021 and 2024) and the Phoenix Mercury (2022).

items.question: Did Diamond DeShields win a WNBA championship?
items.answer: Yes. Diamond DeShields won the 2021 WNBA championship with the Chicago Sky. She was also a 2019 WNBA All-Star and made the All-WNBA Second Team that season.

items.question: Where did Diamond DeShields play college basketball?
items.answer: Diamond DeShields played her freshman season at North Carolina in 2013-14, when she was ACC Rookie of the Year, then transferred to Tennessee. She made the All-SEC First Team in 2017 and left college to play professionally in Turkey before the Chicago Sky drafted her third overall in 2018.

items.question: How tall is Diamond DeShields?
items.answer: The WNBA lists Diamond DeShields at 6 feet 1 inch and 172 pounds. She plays guard.

items.question: Did Diamond DeShields play in Turkey?
items.answer: Yes. Diamond DeShields played professionally in Turkey before her WNBA career, for Cukurova (CBK Mersin) in 2018. She also played for Famila Schio in Italy in 2021-22.
